title: Tales of the Nine Worlds
note: Gods and giants, bound by promises kept at a price.
deck: From Odin's missing eye to the wolf Fenrir's chain: Norse myths of wisdom bought dearly, kept in every version the telling allows.

title: The Olympian Cycle
note: Gods of Olympus, and the mortals who dared to bargain.
deck: Prometheus steals fire, Demeter mourns, Icarus flies too high: Greek tales of gifts that punish the giver, filed beside every variant ending.

title: Shadows of the Floating World
note: Cranes, sea palaces and debts that outlive the debtor.
deck: A crane wife weaving in secret, a fisherman out of time, a drumming tanuki: Japanese stories where gratitude and greed share one roof.
chapters: Urashima Taro and the Palace Under the Sea

title: The Spider's Web of Stories
discipline: West African · Akan and Yoruba lands
note: How Anansi the spider bought every story in the world.
deck: A python, a leopard, hornets and a fairy: the price Anansi paid the sky god for every story, with Yoruba and tortoise tales alongside.
chapters: How Ogun Cleared the Path for the Gods
The Tortoise Who Flew with the Birds

title: The Hut on Chicken Legs
note: Baba Yaga's hut turns to face the polite, and only them.
deck: Vasilisa's doll, a glowing feather, a death hidden in a needle: Slavic tales where the forest tests every visitor's manners first.

title: Mist Over the Green Isles
note: Salmon of knowledge, swan-children, one warrior at the ford.
deck: Fionn's burnt thumb, four swans singing nine hundred years, Cu Chulainn holding a ford alone: Celtic grief carried on the wind.
theme: The isles · grief on the wind

title: Ledger of the Jade Court
note: Moon goddesses, weavers, and a monkey who punched heaven.
deck: Chang'e rises to the moon, magpies bridge the stars for two lovers, a stone-born monkey storms the palace: order, tested yearly.
chapters: The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl
